aboutText: With over 15 years of hands-on experience in Brunswick's residential carpentry, Christos specialises in traditional and heritage-informed craftsmanship. His approach is detail-driven, ensuring every project—from decks to extensions—performs well over time, both structurally and visually. Christos is involved throughout the process, with a keen focus on material behaviour, longevity, and impeccably executed details.
servicesText: Christos offers a range of carpentry services in Brunswick and surrounding areas, including custom deck builds, heritage restorations, and detailed finish work. Each project is tailored to meet specific needs, with a focus on quality materials and traditional techniques that ensure durability and aesthetic appeal.

services.title: Custom Deck Construction
services.desc: Specialising in Silvertop Ash and Millboard decks with custom features for durability and style.

services.title: Heritage Restoration
services.desc: Expert restoration of heritage structures like theatre mezzanines, preserving traditional craftsmanship.

services.title: Porch & Entryway Decks

services.title: Courtyard & Outdoor Carpentry
services.desc: Creating courtyard decks with landings, staircases, and integrated screens for outdoor living.

services.title: Residential Extensions
services.desc: Managing and building extensions with a focus on seamless integration and structural integrity.

services.title: Custom Bench Seats & Screens
services.desc: Designing and crafting custom seating and screens to complement existing structures.

reviews.text: For the restoration of our mezzanine at the Northcote Theatre, Christos brought traditional carpentry skills that truly preserved the heritage character. His hands-on approach and commitment to quality were evident throughout.
